description: Follows an address hop by hop without skipping any: status code, target and time per hop, the final page, loops, temporary (302/307) redirects and https to http drops. For a homepage it also tests the http, https, www and non-www versions and says whether they all end on the same page in one hop. Counts against the free daily limit unless cached.

url.description: The address to test, as typed, for example http://store.com/old-page

name: check_redirects
title: Check the redirect chain of an address
